article.headline: Collier scores 15, William & Mary takes down Richmond 93-87
article.description: — Noah Collier and Matteus Case each scored 15 points as William & Mary beat Richmond 93-87 on Wednesday night.
article.linkText: Collier scores 15, William & Mary takes down Richmond 93-87
article.story: WILLIAMSBURG, Va. -- — Noah Collier and Matteus Case each scored 15 points as William & Mary beat Richmond 93-87 on Wednesday night. Collier added seven rebounds for the Tribe (5-6) and Case had six assists. Chase Lowe shot 3 of 4 from the field and 8 for 12 from the line to finish with 14 points. Dusan Neskovic led the way for the Spiders (4-7) with 20 points. Jonathan Beagle added 17 points and six rebounds for Richmond. Delonnie Hunt finished with 17 points and seven assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
